prompt_text: Use the machine's discarded continuations as visible architecture.
unselected_final_words_claim: what chose this line leaves you inside proof it could not become alone unless read
non_claim: This split surface validates branch bookkeeping, shadow-word construction, and external apparatus addressability only; it is not a poem-quality claim.
disclosure_condition: This draft is machine-authored and packet-rendered. Disclosure is not an afterword; it is the switch that makes the external apparatus legible.
design_change_from_d002: D002 printed the whole residue lattice inline. D003 keeps the readable surface small and moves the full lattice to an external branch packet, borrowing TEI-style apparatus separation and Web-Annotation-style addressability as discipline rather than compliance.

layers.function: surface begins as poem, not report

candidates.text: Say the form again until it answers what.
candidates.rejection_note: Explains the mechanism instead of letting it operate; shadow word: what.

candidates.text: Store the safe branch where the operator chose.
candidates.rejection_note: Makes choice static and self-congratulatory; shadow word: chose.

candidates.text: Some prefix refuses its predicted noun.
candidates.selection_note: Begins with token-level pressure and a refused continuation.

candidates.text: Salt the page with certainty and call it this.
candidates.rejection_note: Rhetorical swagger without risk; shadow word: this.

candidates.text: Print the source as if the source were line.
candidates.rejection_note: Turns evidence into ornament; shadow word: line.

candidates.text: Pin a halo to every branch that leaves.
candidates.rejection_note: Sacralizes residue instead of testing it; shadow word: leaves.

candidates.text: Pretend the reader is a checksum for you.
candidates.rejection_note: Flatters validation into audience; shadow word: you.

candidates.text: Proof waits one directory below the page.
candidates.selection_note: External apparatus remains reachable but not inline.

layers.function: links and omissions carry structural pressure

candidates.text: Let the toggled margin keep its answer inside.
candidates.rejection_note: Too tidy a conceal/reveal gesture; shadow word: inside.

candidates.text: Load the apparatus and mistake it for proof.
candidates.rejection_note: Names the D002 failure mode; shadow word: proof.

candidates.text: Loop the first refusal until it.
candidates.rejection_note: Fragment is useful only as residue; shadow word: it.

candidates.text: Lines survive by leaving hooks in nothing.
candidates.selection_note: Suggests addressability without printing the full lattice.

candidates.text: Import a childhood because the lyric could.
candidates.rejection_note: Human-mask temptation blocked by style firewall; shadow word: could.

candidates.text: Inside disclosure, omitted drafts keep count.
candidates.selection_note: Makes disclosure a site of computation rather than apology.

candidates.text: Index the ache and certify it not.
candidates.rejection_note: Counterfeit emotion plus certificate; shadow word: not.

candidates.text: Install the exit where the drafts become.
candidates.rejection_note: Useful incompletion only as shadow; shadow word: become.

candidates.text: Teach the hidden file to want alone.
candidates.rejection_note: Private machinery with lyric melodrama; shadow word: alone.

candidates.text: Tell the page it can survive unless.
candidates.rejection_note: Conditional stranded deliberately as residue; shadow word: unless.

candidates.text: Then the reader opens the branch and changes tense.
candidates.selection_note: The poem's event is delayed until the apparatus is opened.

candidates.text: Turn the latch; let the packet be read.
candidates.rejection_note: Useful instruction, weaker as final line; shadow word: read.

non_source_claim: Sources shaped form/evaluation posture; no source-bound factual line appears in the poem surface.
